_comment: CANDIDATE sites only. Bounding boxes are approximate and unverified: run `python scripts/fetch_chips.py` and read its per-site loss-rate audit, then adjust boxes so every train/val/test site contains meaningful Hansen loss. Whole sites are assigned to one split to prevent spatial leakage. Season months are the cloud-poorest months of each site; keep before/after seasons identical to avoid phenology false positives.
